## Summary

- What changed?
- Why does this matter to the cleaning-business workflow?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] I tested the affected user flow manually.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when the behavior changed.

## AI-assisted work

- [ ] I reviewed the generated changes before committing.
- [ ] I verified behavior instead of assuming the generated code was correct.
- [ ] I documented any limitation, uncertainty, or follow-up work.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No real client, address, access-code, photo, or API-secret data is included.
- [ ] Access, authorization, and data-boundary effects were considered where relevant.

## Screenshots or recording

Add screenshots or a short recording for visible UI changes when useful.

## Reviewer notes

Anything a reviewer should inspect closely, including trade-offs or decisions.
